The '''Conquest of Sriluur''' was an event in which [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] and its indigenous poupulation, the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], were subjugated by the [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]] and the forces of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].<ref name="DJ" />

==Appearances==
*[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]] {{1st}} {{Flash}}
